newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Premier says no announcements due.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Premier says no announcements due.

text.p: Investment group Premier Investments Ltd, responding to a stock exchange query on a sharp rise in its share price, said on Monday there were no matters of importance that it planned to announce to the market.
However, the company noted that the recent sharp rise in the share price of retailer Coles Myer Ltd has had a dramatic effect on its net tangible assets backing per share.
Premier shares closed 10 cents higher at A$1.25 on Monday compared with a low of 82 cents on February 5.

Premier, 40 percent owned by Coles Myer director Solomon Lew's private investment vehicle, holds 57 million Coles Myer shares. A subsidiary owns another 284,000 shares, giving Premier just over five percent of Coles Myer's issued capital.

"As has previously been advised to the market, based on the current number of issued shares in Premier Investments Ltd, i.e. 93.79 million, a share rise of 10 cents in the price of Coles Myer Ltd increases the value of Premier Investments Ltd by A$5.7 million or 6.1 cents per share," Premier said.
Coles Myer shares closed 15 cents higher at A$5.69 on Monday. The stock has risen from A$5.05 on February 5.
